messages:
emily: Hi team, first day laptop question. MDM enrolled fine but I can't install Homebrew packages that need sudo. Terminal returns: 'sudo: unable to find user admin'. I don't have admin privileges?

it_bot: IT ticket created: #IT-5012. Please paste output of `id -un` and `dscl . -read /Users/$(id -un)` and confirm serial number.

emily: id -un returns 'emily'. dscl output attached. Serial is C02Z9XYZABCD.

ryan_it: welcome @emily! For company-managed devices we give standard users the ability to run sudo for pkg installs via an admin group called 'ops_admins' using a sudoers rule. Can you run `dseditgroup -o checkmember -m emily ops_admins`?

emily: ran it, output: 'not a member of ops_admins'.

ryan_it: ok. Either the enrollment didn't apply group membership, or device wasn't in time to get the join job. Two quick fixes: 1) we can add you server-side (need approval from karen_admin) or 2) you can request a one-time elevation via the IT self-service portal (cert-based). Which do you prefer?

emily: one-time elevation is fine for now. I'm blocked on a dev env setup and have meetings.

karen_admin: approved. @ryan_it please grant one-time sudo token for serial C02Z9XYZABCD for 2 hours.

ryan_it: done. I pushed a one-time elevation token; please run `sudo -E /usr/local/bin/brew install <pkg>` after restarting terminal session. Token ID: tok-2026-03-01-77.

emily: restarted and ran install, worked! brew, docker, and VS Code extensions installed. Thanks.

emily: small doc note: onboarding checklist should mention waiting ~5 mins after enrollment for group membership sync. Saved me a ping.

ryan_it: good note  we'll add a sentence. Closing IT ticket #IT-5012.

it_bot: Ticket #IT-5012 marked resolved by ryan_it.
